name: Drop Bear
description: A wholly fictional Australian creature: an oversized, predatory koala that supposedly drops from eucalyptus trees onto unsuspecting passers-by, used as a long-standing in-joke to prank tourists.

aliases.name: Thylarctos plummetus
aliases.meaning: Pseudo-binomial coined by the Australian Museum for the drop bear

regions: All Australian states and territories (within the joke)
origin: Joke localised to Australia, particularly its eucalyptus forests; told primarily to international tourists.
